headline: SAFF stays at 4.32 on Female Daily (1,746 reviews) for a seventeenth flat day, while another unofficial Tokopedia shop sells SAFF Extrait at Rp169k with 4.9 from 539 ratings.
kpis_note: Awareness and NPS need a consumer survey; they are not measured from public web data.

insights.text: Female Daily flat vs yesterday and vs 9 Nov: Alchemist 4.43, SAFF 4.32 (1,746 reviews), Mykonos 4.26, HMNS 4.15; no product moved. Onix page not found today.
Share gap: Compas Q2 2026 Shopee data ranks SAFF 4th at 3.52%, vs Mykonos 6.75% and HMNS 5.06%.
Retail scores run far above Female Daily: S.O.T.B has 4.9 from 1,423 Zalora reviews but 4.1 from 586 on Female Daily.
Unofficial resellers keep growing: another non-official Tokopedia shop lists SAFF 30 ml Extrait at Rp169k with 4.9 from 539 ratings and no authorised-seller label.
Longevity is the swing factor: a new creator guide reports 4–6 hours on skin, while Omnia's community profile shows about 3 hours.

recommendations.text: Report unverified SAFF resellers on Tokopedia (Troupe, Cascavel, Loui listings), and publish an authorised-reseller list plus a 'how to spot a fake' guide.
Counter Mykonos Soft Hour (in stores from 15 Nov) with ads that use high retail scores (S.O.T.B 4.9 on Zalora, S.O.F.R and ILIAD 4.9 on Tokopedia), and ask happy buyers to review on Female Daily too.
Find out why S.O.T.B scores 4.1 on Female Daily vs 4.9 on Zalora: read its low-star Female Daily reviews and fix the top complaint in copy or product.
Set clear longevity expectations per Extrait and Cloud Mist (hours on skin vs fabric) and add wear tips, starting with Omnia, S.O.T.B, ILIAD and Annabel Lee.
Run a quarterly survey (awareness, NPS) and upload a marketplace export to the Drive folder so low-star themes can be tracked.
